The Company confirms that its half-year report, to 30 September 2026, is expected to be issued in line with the usual timetable, in November 2026. The information contained within this announcement is deemed by Pembroke VCT Plc to constitute inside information as stipulated under the UK version of the Market Abuse Regulations (EU number. 596/2014). Upon the publication of this announcement through a Regulatory Information Service, this inside information is now considered to be in the public domain.
